entities.summary: Luca Moroni Jr. is an Italian chess grandmaster. He is a four-time Italian Champion, winning in 2017, 2022, 2023 and 2025, and winner of chess' Mitropa Cup in 2021. He represented Italian Team at Chess Olympiads in 2016, 2018 and 2022 and at Online Chess Olympiads in 2020.
